ha_base_url.title: Home Assistant address
ha_base_url.description: Complete HTTP(S) address, including any port or path prefix. Credentials, query strings and fragments are not supported.

watch_entities.title: Entities to watch
watch_entities.description: Entity IDs separated by commas or newlines. The ordered union with all control targets and appliance roles is limited to 64 entities. All control lists together allow 63 controls: one per button/scene, three per media player, two per on/off target, three per cover and one per numeric input. Read selection alone never enables writes.

discovery_prefixes.title: Sensor prefixes to discover
discovery_prefixes.description: Optional read-only sensor. or binary_sensor. prefixes, up to eight, separated by commas or newlines. Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores after the dot, such as sensor.kitchen_; a bare domain prefix matches all its sensors. No wildcards or other domains. Discovery fills unused slots within the 64-entity limit after explicit selections and never enables actions. Leave blank to disable discovery.

dishwasher_running_entity.title: Dishwasher running entity
dishwasher_running_entity.description: Optional single entity ID for a read-only dishwasher state card. Adds this exact entity to watched reads. Matches on/running and off/idle; other states remain literal. No actions are enabled. Leave blank to disable the profile.

dishwasher_duration_entity.title: Dishwasher runtime entity
dishwasher_duration_entity.description: Optional single entity ID reporting runtime since midnight, shown in the running entity card as received without inferred units or a countdown. Requires a different dishwasher running entity. Adds this exact entity to watched reads and never enables actions.

washer_remaining_entity.title: Washer remaining-time entity
washer_remaining_entity.description: Optional exact entity reporting washer remaining time, kept as received without units or countdown. The compact summary is visible while the value contains a nonzero digit and the Washer section is enabled. Must differ from the dryer remaining-time and dishwasher running roles.

dryer_remaining_entity.title: Dryer remaining-time entity
dryer_remaining_entity.description: Optional exact entity reporting dryer remaining time, kept as received without units or countdown. The compact summary is visible while the value contains a nonzero digit and the Dryer section is enabled. Must differ from the washer remaining-time and dishwasher running roles.

ha_token.title: Home Assistant token
ha_token.description: Required token for this plugin. Reads and explicitly selected actions use its existing Home Assistant account permissions.

action_entities.title: Buttons and scenes to control
action_entities.description: Optional explicit button.* and scene.* IDs, up to 63, separated by commas or newlines. Targets are also watched. Leave blank to disable button and scene actions. These actions can control household devices. The shared limit is 63 controls and 64 unique watched entities, including dashboard and appliance controls.

media_player_entities.title: Media players to control
media_player_entities.description: Optional explicit media_player.* IDs, up to 21, separated by commas or newlines. Targets are also watched. Offers Play, Pause and Stop. Leave blank to disable media actions. The shared limit is 63 controls and 64 unique watched entities, including dashboard and appliance controls.

binary_entities.title: Switches, helpers and lights to control
binary_entities.description: Optional explicit switch.*, input_boolean.* light.* and fan.* IDs, up to 31, separated by commas or newlines. Targets are also watched. Offers Turn on and Turn off while Home Assistant reports on or off. Leave blank to disable these actions. The shared limit is 63 controls and 64 unique watched entities, including dashboard and appliance controls.

cover_entities.title: Covers to control
cover_entities.description: Optional explicit cover.* IDs, up to 21, separated by commas or newlines. Targets are also watched. Offers supported Open, Close and Stop actions while Home Assistant reports a known state. Leave blank to disable cover actions. The shared limit is 63 controls and 64 unique watched entities, including dashboard and appliance controls.

number_entities.title: Numbers to control
number_entities.description: Optional explicit number.* IDs, up to 63, separated by commas or newlines. Offers a value field and Apply when Home Assistant reports valid numeric bounds and step. Targets are also watched. Leave blank to disable number inputs. The shared limit is 63 controls and 64 unique watched entities, including dashboard and appliance controls.

cover_position_entities.title: Cover positions to control
cover_position_entities.description: Optional explicit cover.* IDs, up to 63, separated by commas or newlines. Offers a position field and Apply when the cover reports a valid position and supports setting it. Targets are also watched. Leave blank to disable position inputs. The shared limit is 63 controls and 64 unique watched entities, including dashboard and appliance controls.

dashboard_layout.title: Dashboard layout
dashboard_layout.description: Compact controls, sections and appliance actions. Every target is explicit; read-only discovery never enables writes.

discovery_domains.title: Domains to display
discovery_domains.description: Optional read-only domain discovery, separated by commas. Fills the remaining 64 entity slots without enabling actions.

notify_home.title: Home state notifications
notify_home.description: Notify about changes to selected switches, helpers, lights and fans, and binary sensors becoming on. Initial states are silent; each entity has a 60-second cooldown.
